sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Alice always feels tired but happy on weekends. This is her weekend timetable.

| Saturday | | Sunday | |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 9 a.m. | have an English class | 10 a.m. | have an art class |
| 12:00 | have lunch at home | 12:00 | have lunch at a restaurant |
| 4 p.m. | play basketball | 3:30 p.m. | have a violin lesson |
| 6:30 p.m. | have dinner | 5:30 p.m. | have dinner |
| 8 p.m. | do homework | 8:30 p.m. | watch cartoons |
| 10 p.m. | go to bed | 9:30 p.m. | go to bed |

questions.prompt: 1. Alice thinks her weekend is ________
questions.translation: 爱丽丝认为她的周末忙碌但快乐。
questions.explanation: 根据第一句“Alice always feels tired but happy on weekends.”结合时间表中满满的安排，可知周末虽然忙碌但很开心。故选 busy but happy。

questions.prompt: 2. Alice always does sports on ________
questions.translation: 爱丽丝总是在周六下午做运动。
questions.explanation: 根据表格 Saturday 的 4 p.m. 行显示“play basketball”可知是在周六下午。故选 Saturday afternoon。

questions.prompt: 3. Alice ________ at 20:00 on Saturday.
questions.translation: 爱丽丝在周六晚上20:00（8 p.m.）做作业。
questions.explanation: 根据表格 Saturday 的 8 p.m.（即20:00）显示“do homework”。故选 does her homework。

questions.prompt: 4. Alice has lunch ________ on Sunday.
questions.translation: 爱丽丝周日在餐馆吃午餐。
questions.explanation: 根据表格 Sunday 的 12:00 显示“have lunch at a restaurant”。故选 at a restaurant。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage: This term(学期), there is an exchange student(交换生)in our class. Her name is Catherine. She tells us something about the clubs in her school in the USA. They have a swimming club. Students in this club can swim fast. There is an art club and a music club. During the Art Festival(艺术节), students in these two clubs can show themselves by drawing and playing the musical instruments. But we don't have any club in our school so she wants to start her own club here.

questions.prompt: 5. Catherine and the writer are ________
questions.translation: 凯瑟琳和作者是同班同学。
questions.explanation: 根据第一句“there is an exchange student in our class. Her name is Catherine.”可知她们是同学。故选 classmates。

questions.prompt: 6. There are ________ clubs in Catherine's school in the USA.
questions.translation: 凯瑟琳在美国的学校里有3个俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 文中提到了 swimming club, art club 和 music club，共3个。故选 three。

questions.prompt: 7. Students in Catherine's school can ________ during the Art Festival.
questions.translation: 在艺术节期间，凯瑟琳学校的学生可以画画展示自我。
questions.explanation: 根据“During the Art Festival, students in these two clubs can show themselves by drawing and playing the musical instruments.”可知可以画画（draw）。故选 draw。

questions.prompt: 8. Which of the following sentences is NOT true?
options: In Catherine's school in the USA, they don't have any clubs.
Students in the swimming club can swim quickly.
Students can dance and play musical instruments during the Art Festival.
questions.translation: 下列哪句话是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第三句“She tells us something about the clubs in her school in the USA.”可知Catherine在美国的学校是有很多社团的，B选项与原文相悖。故选 In Catherine's school in the USA, they don't have any clubs.。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Are you looking for something interesting and would you like to help others when you are free(空闲的)? Join our volunteer club! We have volunteer jobs for all ages(年龄), from twelve-year-old children to people in their sixties.

Hospitals need volunteers to look after the children while their parents are seeing a doctor. Animal lovers can help take care of those dogs and cats without homes. Charles Smith, a volunteer at the age of 18, says, "I often played computer games in my free time before. But now I help the old learn how to use computers."

If everyone helps out a little, we'll have a better world. Call us at 549-3322 or visit our website.

questions.prompt: 9. Charles Smith does volunteer work for ________
questions.translation: 查尔斯·史密斯为老年人做志愿服务工作。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Charles Smith... says, '...now I help the old learn how to use computers.'”可知是帮助老年人（old people）。故选 old people。

questions.prompt:
10. Who can the volunteers help according to this passage?
①children ②old people ③dogs ④cats ⑤geese
questions.translation: 根据这篇文章，志愿者们可以帮助谁？
questions.explanation: 文中第二段提到了帮助 children（儿童）、dogs and cats（无家可归的猫狗）以及 the old（老人），未提及geese。故①②③④符合。故选 ①②③④。

questions.prompt: 11. How many ways can we use to contact (联系) the volunteer club?
questions.translation: 我们可以使用多少种方式联系志愿者俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一句“Call us at 549-3322 or visit our website.”可知有打电话和访问网站2种方式。故选 Two.。

questions.prompt: 12. What's the main idea of this passage?
options: Hospitals need volunteers to look after the children.
Everyone should take care of the animals.
If you are good at computers, you can teach old people.
People can be volunteers to help others in different ways.
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要号召大家加入志愿者俱乐部，通过不同形式在业余时间帮助需要帮助的人和动物。故选 People can be volunteers to help others in different ways.。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 第二节
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文, 从方框所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项, 其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Students can have great fun in the sports club at school. 13. ________ How can you join a sports club in your school? Come and have a look.

First, find the right sports club. If you want to join a sports club, you must love the sport and like playing it. 14. ________ But you must have interest in it. If you don't like the sport, you'll find it boring to be in the club.

15. ________ Some clubs will ask you to try out first. They will always give you some time to prepare(准备) before the tryout. Show them you really prepare well for joining the club.

There are many sports club you can join at school. 16. ________ That's why you must do well at school.

> A. Second, do well in the tryout (选拔).
> B. You don't need to play the sport very well.
> C. But you must also be good at your school lessons.
> D. They can be healthy and make friends here.
> E. So you don't need to do well in school lessons.

options: Second, do well in the tryout (选拔).
You don't need to play the sport very well.
But you must also be good at your school lessons.
They can be healthy and make friends here.
So you don't need to do well in school lessons.
questions.translation: 他们在这里可以收获健康并结交朋友。
questions.explanation: 承接前句在体育俱乐部的益处，补充说明可以保持健康与交友。故选 D (They can be healthy and make friends here.)。

options: Second, do well in the tryout (选拔).
You don't need to play the sport very well.
But you must also be good at your school lessons.
They can be healthy and make friends here.
So you don't need to do well in school lessons.
questions.translation: 你不需要这项运动玩得特别好。
questions.explanation: 后句转折“But you must have interest in it.”说明重在兴趣而非技术顶尖。故选 B (You don't need to play the sport very well.)。

options: Second, do well in the tryout (选拔).
You don't need to play the sport very well.
But you must also be good at your school lessons.
They can be healthy and make friends here.
So you don't need to do well in school lessons.
questions.translation: 第二，在选拔中表现良好。
questions.explanation: 对应第二段的“First...”，第三段段首引出第二点建议“Second, do well in the tryout...”。故选 A (Second, do well in the tryout (选拔).)。

options: Second, do well in the tryout (选拔).
You don't need to play the sport very well.
But you must also be good at your school lessons.
They can be healthy and make friends here.
So you don't need to do well in school lessons.
questions.translation: 但你也必须擅长你的功课。
questions.explanation: 后句解释“That's why you must do well at school.”（这就是为什么你必须在学校取得好成绩），因此前面强调课业成绩。故选 C (But you must also be good at your school lessons.)。

sections.title: 五、完形填空
sections.instruction: 二、完形填空 阅读短文, 理解其大意, 从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Imagine a pottery studio(陶艺工作室) where the pieces are not just molded(塑造)by hands 17. ________ shaped by heartfelt hugs (拥抱). This is the dream brought to life by Patrick Johnston, an American artist whose Hugged & Loved pottery series has attracted (吸引) 18. ________ attention(注意)online.

Johnston knew at the 19. ________ of six that pottery would be his 20. ________. After a kindergarten project, the little boy asked his teacher if he could have some unused clay. "I stood under the 21. ________ tree in the playground, playing with the clay(陶土) in my hand, and I knew that I had found it," Johnston recalls. Since then, he has never stopped 22. ________ with clay.

Now Johnston has a new 23. ________. He invites people into his studio to hug raw clay, allowing couples, friends and families to "print" their hugs into unique forms. A physical touch becomes a way to create a warm and touchable memory. 24. ________ the shape is set(确定), Johnston adds the finishing touch by writing the creators' names 25. ________ their vessels(容器).

It's a healing process for many, forever reminding(使想起)them of 26. ________ they hug.

questions.translation: 不仅仅是用双手塑形，而是通过由衷的拥抱来塑造。
questions.explanation: not just... but... 意为“不仅……而且……/而是……”。故选 but。

questions.translation: 在网上吸引了大量的关注。
questions.explanation: attention为不可数名词，修饰不可数名词用a lot of。故选 a lot of。

questions.translation: 约翰斯顿在六岁时就知道……
questions.explanation: at the age of 为固定短语，表示“在……岁时”。故选 age。

questions.translation: 陶艺将成为他的一生事业/追求。
questions.explanation: 根据后文他一直从事陶艺，可知陶艺是他的一生（life）。故选 life。

questions.translation: 我站在操场的树荫下……
questions.explanation: under the shade tree 表示在遮阴的树下。故选 shade。

questions.translation: 从那时起，他从未停止过与陶土打交道。
questions.explanation: stop doing sth. 表示停止做某事，由于一直从事，never stop working 表示从未停止创作。故选 working。

questions.translation: 现在约翰斯顿有了一个新点子。
questions.explanation: 后文提到他邀请人们到工作室拥抱黏土，这是他的新构想/创意（idea）。故选 idea。

questions.translation: 在形状确定之后……
questions.explanation: 表示在形状定型之后再写上名字，用时间连词After。故选 After。

questions.translation: 在他们的器皿上写下创作者的名字。
questions.explanation: 在容器表面上书写，介词用on。故选 on。

questions.translation: 永远提醒他们所拥抱的那个人。
questions.explanation: 宾语指代被拥抱的人，用连接代词who。故选 who。

sections.title: 六、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 三、语篇填空 阅读短文, 在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空, 使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage: Students are talking about 27. ________ (club) in their school. Judy wants to join the basketball club because he can play it very 28. ________ (good). But he 29. ________ join it because he 30. ________ (have) the English class on their training(训练)day. Sam wants to join the chess club though(虽然) he can't play Chinese chess. He can learn it. He also wants to learn to 31. ________ (play) weiqi, too. Li Lei can read the words 32. ________ feeling so he can join the drama club. They'll go to Classroom 7E 33. ________ 12:00 every Thursday. Alice doesn't know what club she can join. She can play 34. ________ violin. 35. ________ she can also sing. Can you help 36. ________ (she) choose a club?

questions.prompt: 27. ...talking about ______ (club) in their school.
questions.translation: 学生们正在谈论他们学校的各个俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 泛指学校里的多个社团，用名词复数clubs。故选 clubs。

questions.prompt: 28. ...because he can play it very ______ (good).
questions.translation: ……因为他篮球打得非常好。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词play用副词well。故选 well。

questions.prompt: 29. But he ______ join it...
questions.translation: 但他不能参加……
questions.explanation: 根据后文训练日有英语课冲突可知无法参加，填can't。故选 can't。

questions.prompt: 30. ...because he ______ (have) the English class...
questions.translation: ……因为他在训练那天有英语课。
questions.explanation: 主语he为第三人称单数，一般现在时用has。故选 has。

questions.prompt: 31. He also wants to learn to ______ (play) weiqi...
questions.translation: 他也想学习下围棋……
questions.explanation: learn to do sth. 为固定搭配，接动词原形play。故选 play。

questions.prompt: 32. Li Lei can read the words ______ feeling...
questions.translation: 李磊可以富有感情地朗读台词……
questions.explanation: with feeling 为固定短语，表示“带有感情地”。故选 with。

questions.prompt: 33. ...go to Classroom 7E ______ 12:00 every Thursday.
questions.translation: ……在每周四中午12:00去7E教室。
questions.explanation: 在具体的时刻前用介词at。故选 at。

questions.prompt: 34. She can play ______ violin.
questions.translation: 她会拉小提琴。
questions.explanation: play + the + 乐器 为固定结构，填定冠词the。故选 the。

questions.prompt: 35. ______ she can also sing.
questions.translation: 而且她还会唱歌。
questions.explanation: 表示并列递进补充才艺，句首填And。故选 And。

questions.prompt: 36. Can you help ______ (she) choose a club?
questions.translation: 你能帮她选一个俱乐部吗？
questions.explanation: 动词help后接代词宾格her。故选 her。

sections.title: 七、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 四、阅读与表达 阅读短文, 然后根据内容选择最佳答案或回答问题。
sections.passage:
Hello, everyone. I'm Julia. These days, there is always someone asking me, "What club do you want to join?" I'll give him/her a quick answer—the tennis club.

I want to join the tennis club because I can play tennis. My mom, a tennis coach(教练), taught me a lot. I learned how to hold the tennis racket, how to move from left to right, how to hit a ball, etc. Every Sunday afternoon, it takes me four hours to play tennis with my mom.

I like making friends. Joining a tennis club will help me to do it. Students with the same hobby will be brought together. This is why I want to join a tennis club.

questions.prompt: 37. Which club does Julia want to join?
options: She wants to join the tennis club./The tennis club.
She wants to join the swimming club.
She wants to join the music club.
She wants to join the art club.
questions.translation: 茱莉亚想加入哪个俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“I'll give him/her a quick answer—the tennis club.”可知是网球俱乐部。故选 She wants to join the tennis club./The tennis club.。

questions.prompt: 38. How long does Julia spend playing tennis every week?
questions.translation: 茱莉亚每周花多长时间打网球？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Every Sunday afternoon, it takes me four hours to play tennis with my mom.”可知是4个小时。故选 Four/4 hours.。

questions.prompt: 39. What can joining a club help Julia to do?
options: To find a job as a coach.
questions.translation: 加入俱乐部能帮助茱莉亚做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“I like making friends. Joining a tennis club will help me to do it.”可知是交朋友。故选 To make friends.。

questions.prompt: 40. Which club do you want to join? Why? (30 words or more)
options: I want to join the art club because I like drawing pictures and I can also make friends in the club. Drawing pictures makes me feel relaxed. Showing my pictures to my family and friends can make me feel happy.
I don't want to join any clubs because I think clubs are waste of time.
I only want to stay at home on weekends to watch TV.
My school doesn't allow any students to join clubs.
questions.translation: 你想加入哪个俱乐部？为什么？（30词或更多）
questions.explanation: 选项A陈述了想要加入美术俱乐部的愿望和充分理由，符合题意与字数要求。故选A。
